items.item: The page has a breadcrumb or back link to the leave list, a title such as "New leave request", and a single-column form with a visible label above every field and no placeholder-only labels
items.evidence: nav[aria-label=Breadcrumb] 'Leave requests / New request'; h1 'New leave request'; every control has a label.mb-1.block above it (type, start, end, part, reason, approver, cover, attachment). Only the Reason textarea has a placeholder and it also has a label; the approver search input has aria-label. Start and end dates share one row but the form flows as one column.

items.item: Required fields are marked consistently, and optional ones (such as the attachment) are labelled as optional
items.evidence: Required labels carry '*' (Leave type, First day, Last day, Approver) with a '* Required' legend in the header; '(optional)' on Reason, Covering colleague and Attachment (#file-opt). The asterisk toggles for Reason (unpaid) and Attachment (sick over 2 days, parental) via refreshFileLabel.

items.item: Leave type, start date, end date, approver and reason are present; the approver defaults to the employee's manager and can be changed
items.evidence: #type, #start, #end, #reason, #approver-btn all present. state.approver = 'e1' (Le Van Duc, manager:true, labelled '(your manager)'); the searchable listbox combobox changes it via pick().

items.item: Start and end dates each allow a full day, morning half or afternoon half, and a single-day request can be set as a half day
items.evidence: There is only one #part select (Full day / Morning only / Afternoon only), and #part-wrap is shown only when start === end. There is no per-date (start and end) day-part choice, so a multi-day request cannot start or end on a half day. The single-day half day works (workingDays returns 0.5).

items.item: The remaining leave balance for the chosen type is visible beside the form and updates with the selection, and the requested duration in days (such as 1.5) is calculated and shown live
items.evidence: #calc role=status inside the form is rewritten by recalc() on every change: '<n> working days' plus 'Balance: X of Y days remaining . after this request: Z'. Weekends and holidays are excluded. It sits in the form flow rather than in a side panel, and shows a placeholder until a type is chosen. Half-day steps are only possible for single-day requests.

items.item: A request that exceeds the balance, or has an end date before the start date, shows an inline error tied to the field with `aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby`, and the entered input is kept
items.evidence: validate('end') returns 'Only X days of ... left...' and 'Enter a last day on or after ...'; showError() sets aria-invalid='true' on #end and un-hides #end-err, which is listed in #end's aria-describedby. State and field values are not cleared on error.

items.item: The attachment control states accepted file types and size limit, lists the chosen file with a remove button, and is keyboard operable
items.evidence: #file-help 'PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB.'; the 'Choose file' button (#browse) triggers the hidden input; renderFiles() lists name, type and size with a #rm-file 'Remove <name>' button; setFile() validates type and size; Preview and Download links are also present.

items.item: The submit action is a verb label ("Submit request") with a secondary Cancel, shows a busy state while submitting to prevent a double submit, and confirms success with a status message that is announced to assistive technology
items.evidence: #submit 'Submit request' (primary) and #cancel (secondary) in the sticky bar. send() disables #submit, shows #spin and disables the fieldset, and submit() returns early on `if (submitting)`. success() calls toast() into #toast[role=status], and shows the #done confirmation section. The button label does not change while busy; the spinner is aria-hidden.

items.item: Leaving the page with unsaved input triggers a warning, and an option to save as draft is offered
items.evidence: The warning exists: a beforeunload handler guarded by isDirty(), a #leave-dlg dialog (Leave / Stay) on nav links and Cancel, and an 'Unsaved changes' indicator. No Save as draft control exists anywhere in the markup or script.

notes: Audit score 100 with no violations. The screenshot shows a plain white sidebar, flat surfaces, a single blue primary action and 4/6px radii. There are no greeting header, KPI tiles, gradients, glass, emoji icons, uppercase tracked labels, promo card or hover lift. The 'NH' avatar is the signed-in person's initials, which is acceptable. Gaps: no per-date half-day choice for multi-day requests, no Save as draft, and the balance and duration summary sits inline above Reason, not beside the form. The page also has a #error load state, an approver-on-leave server error and a #fail banner, all handled well.
